name: Successful Full Capture
description: Parent answers and provides all required fields in a single call.

name: Partial Capture — Callback Requested
description: Parent answers, gives email and mobile, but asks for a callback on Thursday.

name: No Answer — WhatsApp Fallback
description: Call is not answered; a WhatsApp follow-up message is sent instead.

name: Opt-Out Request
description: Parent answers and immediately requests no further contact.

name: Low Confidence — Human Review Required
description: Parent answers but gives conflicting or incomplete information; confidence score falls below threshold.
